ref: ADR-0004 as amended for F-17: a source queue whose context element never occurs in the message is one empty context, observed for a leaf queue (#31 d3, obs-target-creation create-d) and our rule for every source queue, a structure field's too (SourceQueue.structureField, Projection, po:source-queue); #2 §4 collapseContexts: "Empty contexts are replaced with an empty string" [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/saphelp_nwpi711/helpdata/en/43/c4cdfc334824478090739c04c4a249/content.htm]
note: An empty input: <Orders/> has no Order, so the source structure field Line in its context Order is one empty context, {0,0} (F-17). collapseContexts replaces it with "": one context holding "", so the root's one slot creates one Item, empty. Zero contexts, {0}, would give collapseContexts one empty context and the root no Item, as before F-17. The leaf twin is fn/collapseContexts/003.
